# rediscloud_subscriptions (Data Source)

The Pro Subscriptions data source allows access to a list of all pro subscriptions within your Redis Enterprise Cloud account.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Block, Optional) Optional filters that narrow the returned subscriptions. Omit to return every pro subscription. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filters))

### Read-Only

- `subscriptions` (Block List) A list of the pro subscriptions in the account (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--subscriptions))

<a id="nestedblock--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Optional:

- `name` (String) If specified, only subscriptions with this exact name are returned.

<a id="nestedblock--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_provider` (Block List) A cloud provider object (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--subscriptions--cloud_provider))
- `customer_managed_key_aws_role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role used by the subscription to access the AWS KMS customer managed key. Grant this role access to your KMS key via key policy
- `customer_managed_key_deletion_grace_period` (String) The deletion grace period for the customer managed key (e.g. 'immediate', '15-minutes')
- `customer_managed_key_enabled` (Boolean) Whether customer managed key encryption is enabled for the subscription
- `customer_managed_key_redis_service_account` (String) The Redis service account principal associated with the subscription. This is used to grant access to the customer managed encryption key
- `id` (String) The identifier of the subscription
- `memory_storage` (String) Memory storage preference: either ‘ram’ or a combination of 'ram-and-flash’
- `name` (String) The name of the subscription
- `number_of_databases` (Number) The number of databases that are linked to this subscription
- `payment_method` (String) Payment method for the requested subscription. Either 'credit-card' or 'marketplace'
- `payment_method_id` (String) A valid payment method pre-defined in the current account
- `prometheus_endpoint` (String) The Prometheus scrape endpoint for databases in this subscription. Use this to configure your Prometheus server to scrape metrics from your Redis Cloud databases.
- `public_endpoint_access` (Boolean) Whether public endpoint access is enabled for databases in the subscription
- `status` (String) Current status of the subscription

<a id="nestedblock--subscriptions--cloud_provider"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions.cloud_provider`

Read-Only:

- `aws_account_id` (String) AWS account ID associated with the subscription (only applicable for AWS subscriptions)
- `cloud_account_id` (String) Cloud account identifier, (A Cloud Account Id = 1 implies using Redis Labs internal cloud account)
- `provider` (String) The cloud provider to use with the subscription, (either `AWS` or `GCP`)
- `region` (Block Set) Cloud networking details, per region (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--subscriptions--cloud_provider--region))
- `resource_tags` (Map of String) A map of resource tags associated with this subscription.

<a id="nestedblock--subscriptions--cloud_provider--region"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions.cloud_provider.region`

Read-Only:

- `multiple_availability_zones` (Boolean) Support deployment on multiple availability zones within the selected region
- `networking_vpc_id` (String) The ID of the VPC where the Redis Cloud subscription is deployed
- `networks` (Block List) List of networks used (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--subscriptions--cloud_provider--region--networks))
- `preferred_availability_zones` (List of String) List of availability zones used
- `region` (String) Deployment region as defined by cloud provider

<a id="nestedblock--subscriptions--cloud_provider--region--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions.cloud_provider.region.networks`

Read-Only:

- `networking_deployment_cidr` (String) Deployment CIDR mask
- `networking_subnet_id` (String) The subnet that the subscription deploys into
- `networking_vpc_id` (String) Either an existing VPC Id (already exists in the specific region) or create a new VPC (if no VPC is specified)
